text.text_excerpt: I like indie coffee places, but sometimes I want a weird frappa-something-I-can't-pronounce. When I want something more than tea or black coffee, I head up here. This place is clean, the staff are nice and friendly, the food is just like any other Starbucks, so you know what you are getting.

You can take the guy out of Seattle, but you can't take Seattle out of this guy, so forgive me for violating my "no chains" rule. Yes, I prefer the local coffee shops, but just need a Starbucks fix from time to time. This store has no drive-thru, which is the way they should all be, in my opinion. I visited this store a year or so ago, and recall being less than impressed with the customer service. My next few attempts were met with "closed early due to Covid" signs on the door, so I ordered on the app today with minimal expectations. First of all let me say that I stay in the lower 9th ward in New Orleans Louisiana. I would go to the local coffee shop in the area just like anyone else. Will I continue to use the local shops yes I will but I will also go to Starbucks on Elysian Fields. And I started off with saying that because I see a lot of reviews complaining about a major company taking advantage of the small local businesses. There's room for all. But my experience at this new location was calming . Walking in was very clean and the staff was extremely helpful. Free WiFi was definitely in place because the laptops were definitely in use.
